ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 70-75% high-intensity white pixels across the lobes and 25-30% low-intensity dark pixels concentrated in the central peduncle region and along the upper trailing margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white geometric regions on the left and right lobes; a central dark vertical band with radiating mottling at the base; high-frequency dark focal spots (freckles) distributed across the medial and distal white surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a calculated wide angle of approximately 110-120 degrees and shallow bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular boundary characterized by high-amplitude, low-frequency serrations; notable smooth semi-circular excision on the right lobe; extreme high-frequency pixel variations (bumps) on the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve along the trailing edge leading to pointed distal tips; leading edge exhibits a broad convex curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly concentrated clusters of high-contrast, raised pixel structures (rosettes) localized on the extreme outer tips of both lobes, suggesting dense colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent vertical dark linear mark on the far left lobe; several shorter vertical linear disruptions visible near the base of the fluke.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep semi-circular notch on the trailing edge of the right lobe consistent with significant tissue loss; heavy peripheral encrustation on distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive 'freckling' pattern consisting of small, distinct low-intensity pixel clusters scattered throughout the high-intensity regions of both lobes.
